parameters.name: Frequency
parameters.description: The detection frequency. Valid values: 1m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 20m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 3h, 4h, 6h, 8h, 12h, and 24h.

parameters.name: MonitorCategory
parameters.description:
The detection point type. Valid values:

- 1: PC
- 2: mobile device

parameters.name: TaskType
parameters.description:
The type of the task. Valid values:

1: ICMP. 2: TCP. 3: DNS. 4: HTTP. 5: website speed measurement. 6: file download.
